description: || reports a failed addition in its second operand even when the first is true
notes: The spec gives logic operators no short-circuit rule, so an error in either operand is reported. hashicorp/hcl agrees here because the failed addition leaves an unknown number, which BinaryOpExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression_ops.go) can't convert to bool, although it drops the error of an undefined variable in the same place (or-ignores-error-in-unused-operand).
reference_error: Unsuitable value for right operand: a number is required
